title: Sapphire Pulse Radeon RX 9070 XT 16GB GDDR6 Graphics Card $999 Delivered ($0 VIC, QLD, NSW C&C/ in-Store) @ Centre Com
body:
Deal: Sapphire Pulse Radeon RX 9070 XT 16GB GDDR6 Graphics Card $999 Delivered ($0 VIC, QLD, NSW C&C/ in-Store) @ Centre Com

[tries] I have a 4070 Ti non-super myself, and though I'm tempted it's not really worth it (main thing I need is real DP 2.1 which this lacks anyways) - though you could probably sell your 4070 Ti super and buy this and be up a bit, so if you're going down that path can be worth it.
Also depends how much you value NVIDIA features.
Here's the GPU hierarchy comparisons anyways: https://www.tomshardware.com/reviews/gpu-hierarchy,4388.html
9070XT about 10% faster than a 4070 Ti super
[Caped Baldy] I'm still using my 3070 and heaps of people are using old cards.
Developers need to optimise more and focus on gameplay rather than graphics.
[ColPow11] @Caped Baldy: I'm still using my 3070 without complaints. I'm happy to play older games where my frames a plenty good enough.
[DingoBilly] Not sure why you'd even be considering this.
Your card is equivalent if not better to this one. Makes no sense to change.
Maybe if you were on a 1-3xxx series, but really no point otherwise.
[Pacify] The jump between 9070xt and 4070ti super probably not going to feel that significant.
[RabidWolve] Use DLSS Enabler or the Free Moding tools to get features from the 5xxx series and wait for Next Gen.
[jasswolf] It's up in the air, but currently hovering in the Q3 2027 to Q1 2028 range. Some talk of Q2 2027, I assume that would be fairly late though.
[F1tzChivalry] Sarcasm?
Age-old conundrum. If you want or need it now, buy it now. If you want to pay top dollar for next gen, then wait for next gen.
…or repeat the same mental circle every 12 months then never upgrade due to analysis paralysis.
Either way human beings are interesting.
[Ilikecars] Its not the same conundrum as always. Until recently we saw generational leaps in GPU peformance for the same price. Now we are paying a lot more and arguably getting less generational and more incremental improvements, albiet with some exceptions
[neRok] I reckon get this. It's only a little more expensive than a couple of months ago, and there's little chance of the market being flooded with new-cheap-gpu's, so you should be able to flip it for relatively little cost (ie, own for a year then sell for $700 == $300 to have a ripper gpu for a year) .
[djmm] Bro if you dont need gpu desperately just wait
[theone4u] Many valid points, I may just wait and save up for their top tier gpu.
[saltoftheocean] Good find OP, I suspect this will be a solid deal compared to the higher priced next gen stuff that may or may not release in 2 years’ time.
Still comes with the free game redemption if purchased by 26th September.
[Azif] Yeah curious if this will be better performance to price than the next gen…
[MaxHashrate] NVIDIA cards go up due to AI….
AMD gets discounted often so resale value drops. If it goes up it is cos other NVIDIA cards are out of reach.
[Pacify] If you looking at performance per dollar, its pretty obviously this.
but if you want the slightly better card due to the DLSS factor, its the 5070ti
[HyperX23] Au dollar spring back have anything to do with the price drop? Our currency has been weak the past month apart from AI supply demand issues. I would love to get this card to upgrade my 3080 10GB.
[plmko] Weak? Maybe it rose 1c maybe it dropped 2c, not sure I would say weak.
[ttgoodman] Apparently this isn't the last time that AMD is rising its price , so maybe go now instead of waiting for Black Friday?
[The Fat Cat] I have this card. I bought it at ATL and picked it as:
- Relatively small size for a 9070XT
- 2x 8pin power
- 2x HDMI & 2x DP
I use it paired with a 5700X3D for 4K 120Hz gaming (with FSR4 and FG) on CachyOS
[Ilikecars] Holding on 6900xt until 6000 series nvidia is released
[kid-vhee] 6900xt gang here. Been getting by with my upgrade itch through second GPU. Run all my lossless through second gpu and LLM when I need to.
Playing on 32:9 on some games, but struggle on ultra details, raytrace or or pathtrace. Lossless is just a bandaid/assistant.
With DLSS5 around the corner, hopefully LSFG can adopt DLSS5 (currently theres mods to run on second card, but very alpha in stages).
[Arclightning] Much cheaper than a 5070ti at least, Im personally going to wait till one of the xfx mercury cards go for cheaper but otherwise not bad
[terroz] you missed it from the amazon prime sales
[Arclightning] I did, but I also was not in the place to be looking for gpu prices then, I am now and while Im sad to have missed it, I was busy trying to make sure I didn't go homeless lmao.
[cloudie9] I am holding out for a white colour GPU. Just started the white colour pc build project!
[Apostle0748] I can recommend the PowerColor Hellhound Spectral Radeon RX 9070 XT for a white build - what I have in mine, heatsink is white so it works really well.
[supaozbarginman] I currently have 3070 from old trusty Dell XPS with new upgrade system of ultra7 265kf and z890 with 32g ram, worth an upgrade? I dont game a lot but do enjoy occasional action shooting, or recently playing where winds meet. Thoughts guys?
[Leeroy Jenkins] Is it XPS 8950? Do you know if this fits in that chassis? And what about the Dell's proprietary power connector?
[supaozbarginman] Apology for not being clear. New tower is completely new except the 3070gpu from the xps.
[Leeroy Jenkins] Thanks.
And btw, I have xps 8950 with 3070 with 32G ram running Fedora 44, it runs Where Winds Meet perfectly. Super smooth. It also runs both Onimusha way of the Sword and Paragmata demos super smooth. Dota 2 usually reaches 120FPS. So I don't see a reason to upgrade unless you run into something you can't run well.
I don't have a Windows system so can't comment on that.
[supaozbarginman] @Leeroy Jenkins: Yeah, no doubt. The only difference since upgrade is the loading speed into game and between maps have significantly improved, possibly due to improved RAM speed. I guess I shouldnt spend it unless it's absolutely necessary 🤣
[Cheap Rich Guy] Your current system is fine for your use case.
[iyabi] Just ordered… been hoping for $700s non-xt since last year to upgrade my 2060S… but it only got worse…
Might as well bite now than regretting it later
finger's crossed.. if the AI bubble pops after this ill be the unluckiest guy
[vinataba] Great GPU. Scored it at 889$ in May / June. It's not ATL but still the most sensible upgrade decision for me from a GTX 1080 8GB.
[lemonswags] (profanity) me i missed it im actually crying
[Sammage] I think they just bumped the price to $1,199 🥹 that didnt take long haha
[MrMcHairyHead] So this was in sale for… a grand total of two hours…?
[Ziitek] The Sapphire PURE RX 9070 XT should follow suit?!
